mapper.sql: F.IRFILE_NO, F.IRVRSN_NO, F.IATT_NO, F.SCATE, F.STITLE, F.SDEL_YN, F.SINS_DT, F.SSYS_ID, F.SVIEW_YN, F.SVIEW_CMPLT_YN, A.SNAME AS ATT_NAME, A.SEXT AS ATT_EXT, A.ISIZE AS ATT_SIZE
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_REL_FILE F LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACH A ON F.IATT_NO = A.IATT_NO WHERE F.IRVRSN_NO = #{relVrsnNo} AND F.SDEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY F.IRFILE_NO
SELECT FROM TB_REL_FILE F LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACH A ON F.IATT_NO = A.IATT_NO WHERE F.IRFILE_NO = #{relFileNo}

SELECT FROM TB_REL_FILE F JOIN TB_REL_VRSN V ON V.IRVRSN_NO = F.IRVRSN_NO JOIN TB_PROM PR ON PR.IPROM_NO = V.IPROM_NO JOIN ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS LAW_NO, V2.ICTNS_ID FROM TB_REL_FILE F2 JOIN TB_REL_VRSN V2 ON V2.IRVRSN_NO = F2.IRVRSN_NO JOIN TB_PROM PR2 ON PR2.IPROM_NO = V2.IPROM_NO WHERE PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND ( V2.SFLAG IS NULL OR V2.SFLAG = 'PROMULGATION' ) GROUP BY V2.ICTNS_ID ) MX ON MX.ICTNS_ID = V.ICTNS_ID AND PR.ILAW_NO = MX.LAW_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACH A ON A.IATT_NO = F.IATT_NO WHERE PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND ( V.SFLAG IS NULL OR V.SFLAG = 'PROMULGATION' ) AND F.SDEL_YN = 'N' AND F.SVIEW_YN = 'Y' AND F.SCATE IN ('REL_FILE_1', 'REL_FILE_2', 'REL_FILE_3') AND ( ( PR.ILAW_NO = #{lawNo} AND COALESCE(V.SVRSN_YN, 'N') = 'N' ) OR V.SVRSN_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN V.IRVCATE_NM = '본문' THEN 1 WHEN V.IRVCATE_NM = '붙임' THEN 2 WHEN V.IRVCATE_NM = '양식' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, V.ISEQ, V.IRVRSN_NO, F.IRFILE_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REL_FILE ( IRFILE_NO, IRVRSN_NO, IATT_NO, SCATE, STITLE, SDEL_YN, SINS_DT, SVIEW_YN, SVIEW_CMPLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{relFileNo}, #{relVrsnNo}, #{attNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, COALESCE(#{cate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'REL_FILE_1'), #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{delYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{insDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{viewYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{viewCmpltYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REL_FILE SET SDEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE IRFILE_NO = #{relFileNo}
